name: Kobold Camp Cleanup
objectiveText: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin , then return to Marshal McBride .   Kobold Vermin slain  ( 10 )

comments.body: How hard cud it possibly be...

After the completetion of A Threat Within [Green]Marshal McBride[/Green] will automatically display this quest. Accept it to begin this quest.

1. Leave the [Yellow]Northshire Abby[/Yellow] and head North (to the right). 

1a. Head in that direction until you reach the corner of the first part of the castle (past three threes). Turn east (right) and you will spot [Green]Eagan Peltskinner [/Green] ([Silver]Coordinates: 49, 40 Elwynn Forest[/Silver]). He will offer you to start the quest [Orange]Wolves Across the Border[/Orange]. This is another easy quest that can be done at the same time.

2. Contune in that direction past all the wolves until you reach a camp ([Silver]Coordinates: 48, 36 Elwynn Forest[/Silver]).

3. Here you will see an assortment of Kobolds. You need the Kobold Vermin (level 1-2) which are dressed in red. Kill 10 of these.

        Note: Save everything you get from them! Then you can sell it to the merchant for some money. It may only be a few copper, but you will need it when you comes time to buy your skills. Don't buy anything at this point either. 

        You gain about 50 experiance for killing level 1's and 52 experiance for killing level 2's. You should level by the time you have killed 10 of these.

4. Once you have killed 10 of these head back to the [Yellow]Northshire Abby [/Yellow] and talk to [Green]Marshal McBride [/Green] ([Silver]Coordinates: 48, 43 Elwynn Forest[/Silver]). He should be indicated on your map with a gold dot.

[Blue]     Money Gained: 25 copper
     Experience gained: 170. 
     Reputation gained: 110 for Stormwind.[/Blue]

This quest leads to [Orange]Investigate Echo Ridge [/Orange] as well as a class specific quest, [Orange]Consecrated Letter[/Orange].

Continue Text:

"How goes the hunting, <name>? Have you found and defeated those vermin?"

[b]Location:[/b]  Northshire Abbey; 48.41 (To recieve as well as complete the quest).  Northshire Valley; 51.37 (Kobold Vermin)

[b]Description:[/b]  Level range is 1-2.  There is no aggro proximity here, therefore I don't include level 3 Kobold Workers that are also near.

[b]Experience:[/b] 170

[b]Reputation:[/b]  110 points with Stormwind     

[b]Character:[/b]  Level 2 

[b]Version:[/b]  1.8.4
